notes: A new Blitzbreak logo on the title screen.

Play vs Bots: the teams are on the left and the match settings on the right, each scrolling on its own, and a list fades out with "MORE" at the bottom when there's more to see. Customize shows it too.
Customize: your robot stands on a floor against a lighter sky, so Cracks & Rubble and the Ink Bomb are easy to see.
The team scores at the top no longer go blank after joining a match that's already going.
Casual search: no more bots countdown, which jumped around. The clock counts up, and if nobody's around a game with bots still starts within a minute.
iPhone and iPad: game sound plays with the silent switch on (the volume buttons still work), and music from other apps keeps playing.
The FPS counter stays clear of a phone's rounded corners and notch.
The kill feed no longer shows more than five lines when several knockouts happen at once.
Blitzbreak's privacy policy is at playblitzbreak.com/privacy.html.
